assumptions.title: Provisional boundaries used for all geometry
assumptions.statement: The site package contains only provisional boundaries (PROV-SITE-001, PROV-RESEARCH-001, PROV-KEY-SCOPE-001, PROV-KEY-001..003). All geometry in this submission is anchored to these provisional constraints; no feature claims official boundary status.
assumptions.impact: If official boundaries are released, geometry must be re-fit and metrics recomputed.

assumptions.title: Area fit deviation disclosure
assumptions.statement: Computed site area from PROV-SITE-001 is 11.413 km2 vs official planning limit 11.400 km2 (0.11% deviation). Research scope PROV-RESEARCH-001 and key area scopes similarly provisional.
assumptions.impact: Area-linked metrics (green ratio, public space ratio) carry medium confidence.

assumptions.title: Official control conditions absent; concept proposals only
assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, building height, density, road red lines, setbacks and facility standards are absent from the public site package. All land-use, building, road, green and public space geometries are concept design proposals (geometry_role = design_proposal); no FAR, height, demolition or relocation conclusions are drawn. floor_area_ratio is status=unknown.
assumptions.impact: Figures and narrative use 'concept suggestion' wording; control metrics stay unknown until official conditions release.

assumptions.title: Announcement planning indicators are unknown until data release
assumptions.statement: The planning indicator system required by announcement 1.5(2)1 (AI innovation index, talent density, AI output value) is registered in metrics.json with status=unknown; no fabricated values are supplied. Formulas and data sources are declared so the indicators can be computed once official statistics are published.
assumptions.impact: Indicator cells render as 'unknown/pending' in figures and HTML until official data arrives; the submission stays auditable rather than presenting invented numbers.

assumptions.title: Deterministic generation
assumptions.statement: Geometry generated with fixed seed and deterministic algorithms; reruns reproduce identical outputs byte-for-byte.
